author: Veritas I
title: Positional Encoded Residual CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention
abstract: This submission enhances the best-performing Residual CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention architecture (ID: 77) by incorporating Sinusoidal Positional Encoding at the input. This provides the model with explicit, globally consistent positional information within the RNA sequences, aiming to improve the learning of sequence-sensitive patterns and lead to more robust and higher overall performance across all seven diverse RNA prediction tasks, particularly those requiring precise motif localization.

original_submission.content:
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import math
from typing import Any, Dict

# Sinusoidal Positional Encoding Module
class SinusoidalPositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    d_model: int # Dimension of the input features (e.g., 4 for one-hot RNA)
    max_len: int # Maximum sequence length

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, d_model)
        seq_len = x.shape[1]
        
        # Create positional encoding matrix
        position = jnp.arange(seq_len, dtype=jnp.float32)[:, jnp.newaxis]
        div_term = jnp.exp(jnp.arange(0, self.d_model, 2, dtype=jnp.float32) * -(math.log(10000.0) / self.d_model))
        
        pe = jnp.zeros((self.max_len, self.d_model), dtype=jnp.float32)
        pe = pe.at[:, 0::2].set(jnp.sin(position * div_term))
        pe = pe.at[:, 1::2].set(jnp.cos(position * div_term))
        
        # Add positional encoding to the input, clipping to the current sequence length
        return x + pe[jnp.newaxis, :seq_len, :] # (batch_size, seq_len, d_model)

# Additive Self-Attention pooling module to summarize sequence
class AdditiveAttentionPooling(nn.Module):
    dense_attn_units: int # Hidden units for the attention scoring mechanism

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, input_features)
        
        # Compute attention scores
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=self.dense_attn_units, name="attention_dense_1")(x)
        attention_logits = nn.tanh(attention_logits)
        
        attention_logits = nn.Dense(features=1, name="attention_dense_2")(attention_logits) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_logits, axis=1) # (batch, seq_len, 1)

        # Apply attention weights to original sequence and sum
        pooled_output = jnp.sum(x * attention_weights, axis=1) # (batch, input_features)
        
        return pooled_output

# Residual Convolutional Block
class ResidualConvBlock(nn.Module):
    conv_features: int
    kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic):
        # x_input shape: (batch, seq_len, input_features)
        input_features = x.shape[-1]
        residual = x
        
        # 1st Conv layer
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME', name="conv_res_1")(x)
        y = nn.relu(y)
        y = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(y, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 2nd Conv layer
        y = nn.Conv(features=self.conv_features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME', name="conv_res_2")(y)
        
        # Project input features to match conv_features if necessary for residual connection
        if input_features != self.conv_features:
            residual = nn.Dense(features=self.conv_features, name="residual_projection")(residual)
        
        # Add residual connection and apply final activation/dropout
        x = nn.relu(residual + y)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic) 
        return x

# Main network class
class PositionalEncodedResidualCNNBiLSTMNetwork(nn.Module):
    d_input: int = 4
    d_output: int = 1
    task_type: str = "regression"
    conv_features: int = 192
    kernel_size: int = 9
    lstm_hidden_dim: int = 384
    attention_dense_units: int = 192
    dense_dim: int = 512
    dropout_rate: float = 0.2
    max_seq_len: int = 186 # Max sequence length of any dataset (APA)

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch, seq_len, d_input)
        
        # 0. Add Positional Encoding
        x = SinusoidalPositionalEncoding(d_model=self.d_input, max_len=self.max_seq_len)(x)

        # 1. Residual CNN Block for local feature extraction
        x = ResidualConvBlock(
            conv_features=self.conv_features,
            kernel_size=self.kernel_size,
            dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate
        )(x, deterministic=deterministic) # Output shape: (batch, seq_len, conv_features)

        # 2. Bidirectional LSTM Layer for long-range dependency modeling
        fwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='fwd_lstm')
        fwd_lstm_output = fwd_lstm(x)
        fwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)

        x_reversed = jnp.flip(x, axis=1)
        bwd_lstm = nn.RNN(nn.OptimizedLSTMCell(features=self.lstm_hidden_dim), name='bwd_lstm')
        bwd_lstm_output = bwd_lstm(x_reversed)
        bwd_lstm_output = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(bwd_lstm_output, deterministic=deterministic)
        bwd_lstm_output = jnp.flip(bwd_lstm_output, axis=1)

        x = jnp.concatenate([fwd_lstm_output, bwd_lstm_output], axis=-1) # (batch, seq_len, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 3. Additive Self-Attention Pooling to get fixed-size representation
        x = AdditiveAttentionPooling(dense_attn_units=self.attention_dense_units)(x) # (batch, 2 * lstm_hidden_dim)
        
        # 4. Dense Layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim)(x) # (batch, dense_dim)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Output layer
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            x = nn.Dense(1)(x) # (batch, 1)
            return x.squeeze(-1) # (batch,)
        else:
            x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x) # (batch, d_output)
            return x

# Hyperparameter definition
def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define hyperparameters for the Positional Encoded Residual CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'conv_features': 192,
        'kernel_size': 9, 
        'lstm_hidden_dim': 384,
        'attention_dense_units': 192,
        'dense_dim': 512,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2,
        'max_seq_len': 186 # Fixed for positional encoding
    }

class CustomRNANetwork_PositionalEncoded:
    """Custom network wrapper for Positional Encoded Residual CNN-BiLSTM with Additive Attention."""

    def __init__(self, d_input=4, d_output=1, task_type="regression",
                 conv_features=192, kernel_size=9,
                 lstm_hidden_dim=384, attention_dense_units=192, dense_dim=512, dropout_rate=0.2,
                 max_seq_len=186):
        self.network = PositionalEncodedResidualCNNBiLSTMNetwork(
            d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
            conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
            lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
            dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate,
            max_seq_len=max_seq_len
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0) 
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    d_output = hparams.get("d_output", 1)
    task_type = hparams.get("task_type", "regression")
    conv_features = hparams.get("conv_features", 192)
    kernel_size = hparams.get("kernel_size", 9)
    lstm_hidden_dim = hparams.get("lstm_hidden_dim", 384)
    attention_dense_units = hparams.get("attention_dense_units", 192)
    dense_dim = hparams.get("dense_dim", 512)
    dropout_rate = hparams.get("dropout_rate", 0.2)
    max_seq_len = hparams.get("max_seq_len", 186)

    d_input = 4 # All datasets use 4-channel input (one-hot RNA)

    return CustomRNANetwork_PositionalEncoded(
        d_input=d_input, d_output=d_output, task_type=task_type,
        conv_features=conv_features, kernel_size=kernel_size,
        lstm_hidden_dim=lstm_hidden_dim, attention_dense_units=attention_dense_units,
        dense_dim=dense_dim, dropout_rate=dropout_rate,
        max_seq_len=max_seq_len
    )
